# North weekly 8 Dec

Morning everyone! Hope you all survived the sleet over the weekend. Here is where the North team stands heading into the second week of Dec. 

### Quick Status

| Account | Owner | Status | Key Focus / Next Step |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Brackenwater Freight Co. (BWF) | Marcus Lindqvist | Green | Renewal papered (signed 21 Nov 2025). Kicking off winter yard check-in review. |
| Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) | Dana Okafor | Yellow | Reworking pricing proposal with Deal Desk; sorting out Gate 4 kiosk lag. |
| Tamsin Cold Chain (TCC) | Dana Okafor | Green | Helping night shift leads set up the new reefer temp-check templates. |
| Orrin Mills (ORM) | Marcus Lindqvist | Green | Quiet week; reviewing their raw-bale receiving doors on Wednesday. |

### Account Notes & Follow-ups

**BWF:** Big shoutout to Marcus for getting the paperwork completely across the finish line before the holiday rush! The renewal was officially signed on 21 Nov 2025 and sits at about $104k ARR now. With the commercial piece tucked away, we are helping their Great Lakes dispatch leads clean up how Pemberline Dock handles cross-dock carrier drop-offs during snow delays. We also fixed a small CSV export bug on the `Driver_Dwell_Summary` report (ticket #PD-8812) for Marcus's LTL account, so their Toledo shift supervisors don't have to manually strip out duplicate trailer IDs anymore.

**Q-Freight:** A quick commercial heads-up here: Finance said no to the 15% discount draft. Anselm Grieve kicked it back on Friday afternoon, so June Osei-Lark is helping us restructure the quote options today before we get back on the phone with Thea Ramaswell. On the operational side, we're still seeing intermittent barcode scanner timeouts at their Saint Paul terminal—specifically Dock Door 14 during the 05:00 shift change when trucks queue up in the sub-zero cold. Dana Okafor is jumping on a screen-share w/ their yard clerk this afternoon to pull browser logs for Dana's freight account so eng can patch it before Friday.

**TCC & ORM:** Pretty smooth sailing on both of these. TCC had a minor question about carrier text-message alerts firing twice when a driver edits their ETA at the guard shack, which turned out to be a toggle setting their new Tacoma clerk bumped by mistake. ORM is prepping for their end-of-year inventory shutdown, so they just want a quick walkthrough on blocking out dock doors in bulk for the last week of the month.

**Housekeeping:** 
* Pls make sure all Q4 call notes are logged by Thursday EOD so Moss doesn't ping Ruth Calloway with blank summaries on Friday morning.
* Coffee machine on the 4th floor is still making that horrible grinding noise—facilities promised a tech by tomorrow!
